findings.summary: Failing test and kopeck truncation in CSV Export/Import
findings.description: Header 'Код услуги' instead of statutory 'Код 804н' broke tests and Excel templates. Math.round(basePriceRub) stripped kopecks for items with non-integer prices like 1500.50.

findings.summary: Frontend CSV Export math truncation and missing canonical basePriceRub reading
findings.description: Export used Math.round(((s as any).priceRub ?? ((s as any).priceKopecks ? (s as any).priceKopecks / 100 : 0))) ignoring canonical s.basePriceRub and stripping fractional kopecks.

findings.summary: Missing REST Pricelist Export API with UTF-8 BOM and Excel semicolons
findings.description: Backend lacked GET /api/pricelist/export and GET /api/export/pricelist. Exporting only worked in browser blobs.

findings.summary: Missing Batch Repricing Engine (ACID Transaction & Exact Kopeck Rounding)
findings.description: Clinic lacked server-side mechanism for batch price modification (+X%, fixed delta, round_10, round_50, round_100, none).

findings.summary: Synthetic A16.07.000 mock in 804n nomenclature ingestion fallback
findings.description: Fallback returned non-statutory mock A16.07.000, violating zero-mocks law. Fixed to statutory Order 804n code A16.07.002.

findings.summary: Duplicate generation on repeated rows and hardcoded duration in catalog sync
findings.description: In-memory cache wasn't updated on record creation, causing identical CSV rows to create duplicates. Title matching wasn't normalized for quotes and cyrillic ё. Duration was hardcoded to 30 min.

findings.summary: Missing UTF-8 BOM in leads and patients CSV exports
findings.description: CSV exports lacked \uFEFF BOM, causing cyrillic character corruption (mojibake) in Russian Excel on Windows.
